description: Declared inventory of the check-*.ts gate harnesses. Every harness on disk must appear here exactly once, and every entry must exist on disk. An entry with run:false must carry a reasoned skip block, so the question 'why is this not run?' is answerable from the repository alone. scripts/gates/run-gates.js fails rather than silently omitting anything.

expected.note: Derived from the declared inventory below (81 entries, 1 declared skip), not from any prior run. The driver reports what it measured; if a run disagrees with these numbers it raises EXECUTED_COUNT_DRIFT. Investigate the difference — do not edit this block to make a run agree with it.

evidence.contract: A harness counts as passed only if it yields machine-readable evidence carrying a harness identity and a POSITIVE assertion count. Exit 0 alone cannot distinguish a harness that proved sixty invariants from one that asserted nothing, which is exactly the hole this closes. The driver reads evidence the harnesses ALREADY print — '58/58 assertions passed', '39/39 invariants passed', '46/46 installation route assertions passed', a JSON report carrying "assertions": 41 or "assertions": [ ... ], a 'SUMMARY ... passed=41 failed=0' line — so enforcement needed no harness edits. Missing, malformed, zero, negative, duplicate, forged and stale evidence each fail the run under their own named EVIDENCE_* finding.
evidence.allowlistNote: THE SIZE OF THIS LIST IS THE HONEST MEASURE OF WHAT THIS GATE DOES NOT CHECK. All 80 executed harnesses are evidence-enforced and zero are exempt. Entries are EXACT filenames — the driver refuses any entry containing a wildcard, glob, regex or path metacharacter (EVIDENCE_ALLOWLIST_PATTERN_FORBIDDEN), because one pattern would silently cover harnesses added later and the count would stop being a measurement. The driver also fails if an entry names a file that is not on disk, if an entry lacks a concrete reason or the temporary/migrationPending markers, and if this declared size disagrees with the real length — so the list cannot grow without a visible, reviewable edit. Every entry is printed on the console and in both summaries on every run.

skip.reason: Not a headless harness. It exercises the live order transport end to end — Server-Sent Events fan-out, unauthenticated and unknown-token rejection on both stream endpoints, idle survival with heartbeats, Last-Event-ID replay and cursor-poll latency — so it needs an HTTP origin serving the app. Under the sweep there is no origin, so it would fail on its precondition rather than on the code under test, and a failure like that is noise that trains readers to ignore the gate.
skip.requires: A running app origin (npm run dev, or a deployed/tunnelled host passed via --base). Its default idle-survival leg also holds the connection open for --idle-seconds, which is minutes of wall clock on its own.
skip.howToRunManually: From aiclone/, with the app serving: $env:TS_NODE_PROJECT="scripts/tsconfig.checks.json"; node node_modules/ts-node/dist/bin.js -r tsconfig-paths/register scripts/one-off/check-order-stream.ts --idle-seconds=330    (add --base=https://<host> to test a specific hop). Documented in scripts/README.md under 'Live order transport'.
skip.declaredBy: Q1-A, 2026-08-30. Carried over from the pre-repository driver (night-run/run-h0-gates.ps1), where the same single skip lived in an unexplained $skip array. This entry exists so the exclusion is auditable from the repository.
skip.reviewBy: Whoever makes the order stream testable without an origin (an in-process HTTP harness would let this move to run:true). Until then this is the only harness the sweep does not execute.
